clue.text: Somewhat irreverently returned? In your dreams

indicators.note: somewhat means only some of the word is kept, the rest cut away
returned means the kept letters run back the other way

parts.note: irreverently cut down to five letters of its middle stretch, also dropping the R and E that sit between

explanation.surface: A cheeky retort to someone asking something back, dismissed as a fantasy.
explanation.walkthrough: The setter slipped: the intended reversed hidden word fails, as the run inside irreverently is REVEREN, two letters too long. Read 'somewhat' as picking only some letters and it works.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are scornful replies meaning something will not happen at all, so the idiom equals the answer.
